title: Proof of Equation of Motion in Linearly Accelerating Frame
assumptions: Frame S' moves with linear acceleration a_0 relative to inertial frame S
starting_principles: Newton's second law in inertial frame

ordered_steps.explanation: Relate position vectors r and r' via origin displacement R_0.
Differentiate twice with respect to time to relate accelerations.
Multiply by mass m and substitute inertial second law F_real = m a.

limiting_cases: When a_0 = 0, frame is inertial and F_pseudo vanishes
claim_traces: HCV1 Ch 5 p. 88; Feynman Lec 12 p. 12-11
